ig:
A small Monday exercise.

Before the inbox takes over, write down one task you did three times last week. Copying an order into another system. Sending the same reminder. Building the same report.

If it's repetitive, rule-based and boring, it's a good candidate for automation. That one line is your first brief.

What's on your list?

li:
A useful Monday exercise for any team lead:

Ask everyone to write down one task they did three times last week.

You'll get a list of copy-pastes, reminders and reports that nobody enjoys and everyone assumes is "just part of the job".

Repetitive + rule-based + low judgement = a strong automation candidate. That list is a better starting point than any AI strategy deck.
